mapper.select: SELECT c.id as commentId, c.vloger_id as vlogerId, c.father_comment_id as fatherCommentId, c.vlog_id as vlogId, c.comment_user_id as commentUserId, c.content as content, c.like_counts as likeCounts, c.create_time as createTime, u.nickname as commentUserNickname, u.face as commentUserFace, fu.nickname as replyedUserNickname FROM comment c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.comment_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN comment fc ON c.father_comment_id = fc.id LEFT JOIN users fu ON fc.comment_user_id = fu.id WHERE c.vlog_id = #{vlogId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
